fields.description: Master switch for the BBPL Approvals app. OFF = maintenance notice. Fail-open: unset counts as ON.
fields.label: Enable Executive PWA (/exec)

fields.description: OFF = installed phones unregister their service worker on next launch (emergency cache disarm, no deploy). Fail-open.
fields.label: Enable Executive PWA Service Worker

fields.description: In-app alerts bell. Independent of the desk Notification Center switch. Fail-open.
fields.label: Enable Executive PWA Alerts Bell

fields.description: Bell to the executive's own account on every new sign-in. Fail-open.
fields.label: Bell Alert on CEO/MD Sign-in

fields.description: OFF removes the Overview tab and refuses its endpoint without touching the inbox. Fail-open.
fields.label: Enable Executive Overview Tab

fields.description: OFF removes the department-wise Usage tab (CEO/MD only) and refuses its endpoint without touching the inbox or Overview. Fail-open.
fields.label: Enable Executive Usage Tab

fields.description: Fail-CLOSED: unset counts as OFF. Requires VAPID keys in site_config.json.
fields.label: Enable Lock-Screen Alerts (Web Push)

fields.description: ON = log what WOULD send, send nothing. Unset counts as ON (rehearse).
fields.label: Push Dry Run (log only, send nothing)

fields.description: OFF = document type + number only. Supplier and cost centre are NEVER included. Unset counts as OFF.
fields.label: Show Amount on Lock Screen
